item.title: YTKillerPlus v21.36.6
item.description:
YouTube 21.36.6 | YTKillerPlus_21.36.6_6.1
### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
- **Cracked by** [u/lowiqentity](https://www.reddit.com/user/lowiqentity/)
> [!NOTE] > - **Sidestore is no longer supported!!.** > - **YTUHD** is not included. 4K is available for A16+ devices. > - use **YTKACE** for downloading. dev intentionally broke download feature. > - - - > #### Extra Tweaks: > - `YouPip` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality` `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks` > - `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino` `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`
> [!WARNING] > - Extra tweaks that are bundled may be unstable on newer versions.
> [!WARNING] > - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.

item.title: YTKillerPlus v21.35.3
item.description:
YouTube 21.35.3 | YouTube_21.35_YTKillerPlus_6.5
• v21.34 requires iOS 17 and later now • Fix HLS CKU clear known url for audio mp3 and 2k-4k capable devices fails on v21.31+ in some cases • Fix save posted gif image saving only first frame in some cases • Fix save posted image when multiple imge in a post first image not saved correctly • Fix tabs Icon. • Fix and improve audio languages select. • Updated iPA to newer YouTube v21.34.6. • Add POST tab to tab bar. • Improve localization & add missing languages. • Improve ad blocking on main Feed. • Improve Lyrics API speed & accuracy. • Improve MP3 audio handling. • Improve backup & restore. • Improve media extension importing. • Improve Shorts auto-skip. • Improve Shorts multiple-post handling. • Fix OLED keyboard issue on iOS 27. • Other fixes & cleanup. • Updated iPA to YouTube v21.35
